newsitem.title: USA: Donegal offers to buy Old Guard Group.
newsitem.headline: Donegal offers to buy Old Guard Group.

text.p: Donegal Group Inc said on Thursday it offered to buy all the outstanding capital stock of Old Guard Group Inc, after Old Guard companies completed their conversion into stock insurance companies.
But Donegal said Old Guard's board had declined to further consider Donegal's proposal and told Donegal the proposal was inconsistent with its plan of independence.
Old Guard asked Donegal to withdraw its application, Donegal said, but Donegal declined.
Donegal said according to filings made with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Old Guard Companies had direct premiums written of $62.6 million for the nine months ended September 30.

Donegal said it proposed merging Old Guard with one of its subsidiaries, and distributing $27.5 million to Old Guard Companies policy holders instead of issuing non-transferable subscription rights to them.
